To suggest a blanket lack of tax contribution ignores the vast majority of immigrants who are employed, legally present, and participating in the U.S. economy. Their value to the U.S. is not just measured in dollars paid to the Treasury, but in the economic dynamism, labor supply, and entrepreneurial spirit they inject into our society. Focusing on an unfounded tax deficiency distracts from the undeniable fact: **immigrants are integral, contributing members of the American economic fabric.**
